# M2 art-director critic (desktop 1440, D + A frames in docs/build/m2-after) — 2026-09-29

(Report of the art-director critic agent, verbatim in substance. Frame names: D = default, A = ?variant=alt; D10-act-N-{enter,mid,settled} are the transition triples.)

1. CRITICAL — ALT plates render blank: A43–A46 (all 4 films screens black), A25 (gauntlet board missing), A29 (drone band missing). Critic's inferred cause: useEnterOnce observes the SAME element that carries a zero-area clip-path (film-frame.tsx:76 `circle(0%)`; SettleFrame "wipe" `inset(0% 100% 0% 0%)` in components/worlds/idiots/chalk.tsx:49) so it may never reach "entered". Fix: put `ref` on an unclipped wrapper (film-frame.tsx: move ref to the outer div; chalk.tsx: <div ref className><motion.div style={{clipPath}}>…). NOTE (executor): a probe found the <img>s loaded (complete, opacity 1) — VERIFY whether the clip-path wrapper stays closed on slow/incremental scroll; also the capture shot may have fired before /_next/image finished (harness now waits).
2. MAJOR — alt journey captions never appear (A21, A23; D21/D23 fine): journey-voyage.tsx:263 `showCaption` depends on `!sailing` which seems stuck true at rest. Fix: reset `sailing` after duration+100ms fallback; show caption when `!seq.ready`.
3. MAJOR — hero doesn't read as Pirates (D01, A01, D00-landed): Pearl is a ~30px speck, teal surf reads as a bioluminescence ad, lens brackets frame the wave not the ship; the flight caption has faded by landing. Fix: widen MV-01 focalBox so the lens frames wave + Pearl; add a persistent `cap.hero` "THE BLACK PEARL ON THE HORIZON • PIRATES OF THE CARIBBEAN" (`under` / poster only, the hero loops).
4. MAJOR — caption line breaks split the film title (D32/A31 "RED / DEAD REDEMPTION 2", D10-act-3 3 lines, A38 "LUMOS • / HARRY POTTER"). Fix: `.scene-caption__film{white-space:nowrap}` ≥640, `text-wrap:pretty` not balance; card-shell.tsx:297 caption cell sits in a shrinking `auto` column → give it `sm:w-[min(46vw,38rem)]` or grid `grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,38rem)]`.
5. MAJOR — act-card film title jammed under the fixed header (D10/A10 act-2/3/4 mid+settled): "3 IDIOTS", "RED DEAD REDEMPTION 2", "HARRY POTTER" sit ~10px under the bar and read as chrome; meta line lost. Cause: min-h-svh rows [1fr_auto_1fr] with a full-width 2.39:1 frame (~600px) leave ~150px per bar. Fix (card-shell.tsx:249/270): cap the frame `sm:max-h-[calc(100svh-var(--header-h)-14rem)]` centred, or first row `minmax(calc(var(--header-h)+7rem),1fr)`.
6. MAJOR — mid frames don't show both worlds / lack captions: D10-act-4-mid & A10-act-4-mid = black void + line of candles (neither camp nor hall visible); D10-act-3-mid identical to settled (tintype fully developed before mid); act-2 enter/mid never show `cap.act-2.out` ("THE KRAKEN'S STORM"). Fix in components/sections/act-card/frames/*: act 4 hold the camp ember glow until p≈.45 and bring the hall in at 20–40% from p≈.35; act 3 map develop to p .15–.7; outgoing caption visible p .1–.45.
7. MAJOR — hard edges/seams: D10-act-1-enter Pearl plate starts at a hard horizontal edge (T2 wants aperture/feather → `mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom,transparent,#000 14vh)`); Jolly Roger is a flat vector sticker floating off the mast, clipped in A10 (register to pearl.mastTop or drop); D10-act-2-mid teal polyline seam razor-hard, rain streaks over the hall (feather the seam mask ~24px, chalk dust, stop rain below the seam); A10-act-2-mid duster wipe = torn horizontal strip that reads as a glitch (feathered L→R diagonal sweep); D10-act-3-enter visible band where house blue-black meets warm rdr2 ground (y≈320) → extend films' last article with a 24vh gradient into --rd-deep (T6/T7, films-section.tsx).
8. MAJOR — alt intro landing (A00-flight-mid) is a hard-edged rotating card; "SKIP INTRO" rotates across MENU; an HP map-fold performed on a Pirates image. Fix in components/intro/controller.js fold(): hide skip when the fold starts (`.intro-fold [data-intro-skip]{opacity:0}`), foldShade to parchment alpha ≥ .8 by p=.35 so the turning page reads as the Map, soft edge shadow.
9. MAJOR — captions promise what the image doesn't show (lib/film.ts captions): D22 "THE CURSE OF THE AZTEC GOLD" over an empty storm (retitle e.g. "THE STORM OFF ISLA DE MUERTA" or add a chest); A10-act-1 "THE CHART TO ISLA DE MUERTA" sits under the ship (move `under` the chart box); D30 "VIRUS'S ASTRONAUT PEN" points at a 56px doodle that reads as a sled (enlarge ≥120px beside the caption); A10-act-2 "WIPED CLEAN" over a board still showing FIG. 0; D43 "THE BLACK PEARL AT ANCHOR" shows intact grey sails (tattered black sails needed: regenerate F-PC or retitle).
10. MAJOR — default principles map doesn't read as the Marauder's Map (D38, D39): looks like a beige form with boxed rows. Fix principles-map.tsx: hand-inked corridor walls instead of rectangular row borders, 2–3 fold creases with panel shading, denser/larger footprints, a lettered banner title in IM Fell.
11. MINOR — the most famous lines are 10px mono (D43–D46 "AAL IZZ WELL.", "NOT ALL TREASURE…"): film-screen.tsx:104 rendition "caption" → "lettered"; register strings in `lettering`; re-run scripts/fetch-display-fonts.mjs.
12. MINOR — finale strokes look like bugs: D44 seven gate glyphs dark on pale sky read as fence posts (chalk white + dark 1px halo); D45 and D10-act-3 floating hachure arcs + stray diagonal (drop, or 40% following the ridge) — finales.tsx.
13. MINOR — contact D40: caption stacked on the h2 (two display lines compete); candle plate shows its rectangular edge → caption `under` the plate; plate `mask-image: radial-gradient(…)`.
14. MINOR — voices D31: testimonial text over the lit tent/tripod (widen left scrim --rd-deep 0–45%, transparent by 65%; caption `head`); D10-act-4-enter camp caption right edge x≈1007 overshoots the gutter (978) → `right:max(24px,var(--gutter))` for br over full-bleed.
15. MINOR — alts barely differ / artifacts: A01 == D01; A10-act-2-settled same hall re-cropped + horizontal scanline banding (idiots rule/grid overlay leaking over the plate?); D36/D37 orange 3px bars at both viewport edges; D33 flat beige "ILLUSTRATIVE MAP" box with right 2/3 empty; D20 header act label missing.

Strong (keep): D00/A00 play screen; Act I Black Pearl plate; act-4 settled Great Hall (best scene); A10-act-3 Dead Eye; D35 WANTED; D31/A31 camp; D46 Hogwarts Express; D44 yellow scooter at Pangong; D29 drone on campus; D36/D37 journal pages; D23 "bring me that horizon"; D25 chalkboard gauntlet with the Kalam quote; credits each title in its own face ending "Mischief managed."; the caption system overall.
